propositions: outcome_counts telemetry (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) generated by verify_findings() in review_kernel is not currently exposed to either plan_review or code_review consumer pipelines at the *_decide boundary
code_review_decide logs contract violations but does not record them to a shared sink, so violation data never reaches finalize_code_review_verdict's coverage unlike plan_review
plan_review_decide records contract violations via a ContextVar-backed sink private to plan_review/orchestrator.py that must be moved into review_kernel as a shared implementation

a new shared helper decide_outcome_counts() must derive single-run outcome tallies from data available at the merged *_decide boundary (empty_outcomes, recovered, clean; unrecoverable always 0 per workflow engine's repair layer)

code_review_decide must be wired to activate the shared contract-violation sink in gate_dispatch._run_code_review_gate and drain it into finalize_code_review_verdict's coverage, mirroring plan_review's pattern
